title: Trigger
description: A git trigger: when swarmupd starts something. A machine runs it only after `swarmupd.triggers.<root>: true`.

every.description: Fire at this interval, such as `30m` or `24h`. A new trigger fires at once.

at.description: Fire once a day at this local time, such as `09:00`.

cron.description: Fire on a five-field cron expression in local time, such as `0 9 * * mon-fri`.

webhook.description: Take deliveries at `POST /hooks/<root>/<name>` on swarmupd's inbound listener (`swarmupd.hooks`). A delivery files a finding for triage; it runs the action only where the machine sets `swarmupd.hooks.direct.<root>.<name>: true`.

verify.description: hmac: an HMAC-SHA256 of the body in `header`. bearer: `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. linear: the `Linear-Signature` header. slack: the `X-Slack-Signature` header with a timestamp at most 5 minutes old.

secret.description: The name of the value in `secrets.yml` (beside the user config) that signs deliveries. Never the secret itself: trigger files are in git.

header.description: hmac: the header with the signature, hex, with or without `sha256=`. Default `X-Hub-Signature-256`.

delivery_header.description: The header with a delivery id, for dedupe. Default `Linear-Delivery` for linear and `X-GitHub-Delivery` for hmac; the body hash dedupes too.

rate.description: Deliveries a minute the listener takes for this trigger. Default 30.

action.description: run: start an agent. workflow: start a store workflow. repeat: create the task of a repeat.

prompt.description: run: instructions for the run; the standard prompt without them.

task.description: run: the task of this store the run works on.

title.description: workflow: the milestone title instead of the workflow's.

repeat.description: repeat: the repeat (`repeats/<name>.md`) whose task to create now.

runs_on.description: Machines (`machine` in each user config) that run the trigger; unset: every machine that turned triggers on for this store. Required for action workflow and repeat, so one fire time starts once.

enabled.description: Default true; false keeps the file and fires nothing.
